name: Ki no Tsurayuki
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 35); Porter’s note gives the dates as: 884–946.

poems.title: The village of my youth is gone
poems.author: Ki no Tsurayuki
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 35
poems.text:
The village of my youth is gone,
New faces meet my gaze;
But still the blossoms at thy gate,
Whose perfume scents the ways,
Recall my childhood’s days.

poems.title: 35. 人はいさ 心もしらず ふるさとは (Hito wa isa kokoro mo shirazu furusato wa)
poems.author: Ki no Tsurayuki
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 古今集
poems.text:
人はいさ 心もしらず ふるさとは
花ぞ昔の 香ににほひける
